resources.string: Learns the basal from clean hours and proposes small changes. Nothing changes without your tap.
Learner: a basal proposal is ready. Open the Learner to see it.
No check yet. The first one runs at 06:00.
Seen on two checks in a row; half way to the measured need, at most 20 % per step.
The profile is edited in place (same name) and switched to at 100 %. The pump gets the new basal.
What the last check measured (profile / need)
Applied: the profile is edited and active at 100 %.
The profile is edited, but the switch to it failed. Switch to it by hand.
The profile of the proposal no longer exists. Nothing changed.
The profile was edited after the check. The proposal is dropped; the next check makes a new one.
The edited profile is not valid (%1$s). Nothing changed.
